p1: farmer recovery lease: observed/queue-attempted/queued/turn-started/running/succeeded; capture queue stderr/exit; pending watchdog; manual retry linkage; no resume after successful task_complete; project-root sessions only; original model preserved
research-state status presenter: unified NOW/workflow/next-action/blocked view; explicit IDLE/unactivated state; openable in Codex panel without native UI extension or second writable state
goal/checkpoint adapter: map runtime goal/checkpoint signals to research-state without duplicating scientific goal data or treating goal completion as research success
go-on continuation protocol: multi-source recovery, TODO/checkpoint inheritance, native session first, manual reconstruction fallback and one-shot confirmation
auto convergence guard: goal inheritance, stop-on-stall, interruption, convergence evidence and no bypass of contract/publish/archive gates
hook and failure-injection tests: queue failure, stale lock, owner mismatch, manual retry, no-new-turn timeout, cancel and success-no-resume
p2: team heartbeat, health-check, local re-dispatch and integration sampling
review feedback verification and technical rebuttal closure
up capability comparison matrix, skill-table/interop checks and one-candidate self-evolution
cross-platform field normalization in existing ledger without importing configure data/runs layout
rejected_or_deferred: configure/data/runs/<run-id> as a muIon-beam storage layout: conflicts with Gitee-pull continuity and current canonical paths
configure launcher defaults and shell deployment: machine-specific and outside research workflow scope
external plugin installers, hooks and launchers: not executed or copied
Codex native UI extension: unnecessary for first visibility layer and not required for the derived status presenter
automatic model fallback on capacity errors: user selected original-model preservation
treating configure's completion/convergence as a scientific verdict: rejected by research contract boundary
